weight_gain_cause:
PESO HABITUAL RONDAVA 70KG;
ENTRADA NA UNIVERSIDADE POTENCIOU AUMENTO DE PESO, QUE DEPOIS CONSEGUIU PERDER AUTONOMAMENTE. QUANDO FOI PARA A ALEMANHA EM 2014 JÁ TINHA 70KG E DEPOIS FOI GANHANDO GRADUALMENTE. EM 2017 DEPOIS DA GRAVIDEZ VOLTOU A AUMENTAR PESO GRADUALMENTE. BEBE NASCEU DE 26 SEMANAS, PREMATURO, NÃO SABIA QUE ESTAVA GRAVIDA NESTA ALTURA. ALTERAÇÃO DA ROTINA (FILHO NOS CUIDADOS INTENSIVOS DURANTE UNS MESES) TAMBÉM INTERFERIU NO AUMENTO DE PESO.
weight_gain_cause_en: "usual weight was around 70kg; starting university led to weight gain, which I was able to lose on my own later. when I went to germany in 2014, I was already 70kg and then gradually gained weight. in 2017, after the pregnancy, I started to gain weight gradually again. the baby was born at 26 weeks, premature, and I didn't know I was pregnant at that time. changes in routine (child in intensive care for a few months) also interfered with the weight gain."

"minimum weight in adulthood 58kg (about 26 years ago) 
maximum weight in adulthood = 86kg (about 5 years ago when they quit smoking) 
usual weight hovers around 70kg in the last year. 
tells me that they have lived on a diet their whole life, but sometimes they fall into unhealthy eating patterns and that is when they gain weight."
